name: stats-section
blurb: Dark-themed section with animated stats grid and narrative copy on a two-column layout.
description: Full-section component with dark background (neutral-950) and purple radial gradient. Left column shows heading, stat grid (Founded, Remote, Capital, Partners), and right column contains narrative paragraphs. Stats animate in on scroll with staggered delays. Hardcoded content.
use_when: Startup or company About sections where you want to combine stats with narrative storytelling.
avoid_when: Reusable stats component; data and text are hardcoded.
a11y: Semantic section and heading elements (h2 with br for line break). Stats animate but all text is readable. Purple gradient background uses radial-gradient, which is purely decorative.
